message.content:
Sure thing! To craft a trip that feels just right for you, could you let me know a bit more about your plans?

| What I’d love to know | Why it matters |
|------------------------|----------------|
| **Length of stay** (days) | Helps me spread out activities and downtime. |
| **Travel dates / season** | Weather, crowd levels, and special events vary. |
| **Budget range** (per person) | Guides flight, hotel, dining, and activity choices. |
| **Accommodation style** (hotel, boutique, Airbnb, etc.) | Ensures the vibe matches your taste. |
| **Main interests** (art & museums, food & wine, history & landmarks, shopping, nightlife, day‑trips, etc.) | Lets me prioritize what you’ll love most. |
| **Any special needs or preferences** (e.g., dietary restrictions, mobility concerns, language, etc.) | Makes the trip smoother and more enjoyable. |

Once I have those details, I can put together a personalized itinerary—including flights, lodging, daily plans, dining spots, transport tips, and a rough budget breakdown. If you’re happy with a general “classic Paris” outline, just let me know and I’ll dive straight in!
